  "body": "## This is a Feature Proposal \r\n\r\n* This issue is part of the GDPR EPIC #3320 \r\n\r\n#### :tophat: Description\r\n\r\nThis is a feature proposal to have a better compliance with [GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Data_Protection_Regulation). \r\n\r\nWe need to track when a user has accepted the TOS (Term Of Service), so if it gets changed we should show the TOS page to accept again.
